document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
Hideous!  Unbelievable!  Man-sized  pink  lobster-like  things 
crawling  over  the  stones! You  hear  an  insane  shriek—and  a 
moment passes before you realize the scream was yours.

You dash back to your comrades yelling: “Let’s get out of here!” 
They race after you.
Gain 1 point of Cthulhu Mythos. Go to 143.
